games.title: Ghosts of Faces
games.note: Show, don't tell: the voice-over goes by in captions while you play; lines the picture already says are cut; glints instead of hints; new staging (13th floor, the phone, the escalator, Boris's show, the montage, your own face).

games.title: My Platformer
games.note: Boots straight into the Playtest Room now (no logo, title or menu); Start restarts the room fresh. Night sky: black with two layers of parallax stars that drift slower than you as you move. Ledges: touch a wall with its top edge anywhere between your hands and feet and you pop straight into the hang; the plug zipping to a socket near the top of a wall also ends in a hang. The brown mech yard door has a gap at the top: wall jump up either side (3 wall jumps) to get in and out without the mech.

games.title: Kota Chomp DX
games.note: Jump layering, and the big cat's colour. Small cat, straight away: jump over your own body and the body should stay unbroken under the arc instead of stopping dead at the cell you crossed; where the arc's ground shadow crosses your body the body is drawn over the shadow now rather than cut by it; and in a jump the head is drawn on its own, with no neck stub poking out behind it off the back of the arc. Evolved, so a long run (length 100): the detailing pixels along the big cat's bottom edge and inside its fill are a light tint of the body yellow instead of black, the body's bottom outline and the adult arc's feet are that same shade, and the detailing no longer turns red where the cat crosses the person's feet. What to judge: whether the tint reads as shading rather than as dirt, and whether a jump's silhouette is clean now.
